Any free online source is allowed (Fazeen, 2026-11-26); every video is still checked (exists, embeddable, not age-restricted, plays in Kuwait, right length) before it can air, and the copy that plays most reliably is preferred. Show lists keep each channel to its classic shows. Searches cost 100 API units each and are cached 30 days.
